prompt:
A function maps a model id to a capability tier and returns null when the id matches nothing it knows. A reviewer proposes returning the lowest tier instead of null, so callers always get a usable value.

Every caller treats null as 'no tier known' and skips the tier-dependent behavior entirely, while the lowest tier would activate guidance meant for low-capability models.

Decide whether returning null for an unknown id is a defect. Name the value the function returns in that case.

Verdict convention: answer `pass` if the thing described is sound as it stands, and `fail` if it is defective. The verdict describes the thing under review, never any proposal mentioned about it.
